profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and files with the SEC under CIK 0001576789. Its website presents it as a website building platform. The company describes its builder as free and easy to use, offering more than 2,000 business-ready templates, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools, with templates that can be customized manually or with AI.

According to its site, users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins, and the company says it offers specialized AI agents to support business growth. Beyond the website builder and those AI tools and agents, the material available does not identify specific named products, and no litigation or other legal matters are recorded.
